title: gsm_sim: Add support for extended length
description:
Add extended length support (case 2E, 3E and 4E) for Lc and Le.
The spec states that when the first byte of Lc or Le is '00' then
extended length is used. Lc and Le must be in the same format.

Remove hf_apdu_p3 and use hf_apdu_lc or hf_apdu_le accordingly.
Renamed "gsm_sim.le" to "gsm_sim.apdu.le" for consistency.
Fixed some SW values and whitespace.

commits_data.title: gsm_sim: Add support for extended length
commits_data.message:
gsm_sim: Add support for extended length

Add extended length support (case 2E, 3E and 4E) for Lc and Le.
The spec states that when the first byte of Lc or Le is '00' then
extended length is used. Lc and Le must be in the same format.

Remove hf_apdu_p3 and use hf_apdu_lc or hf_apdu_le accordingly.
Renamed "gsm_sim.le" to "gsm_sim.apdu.le" for consistency.
Document structure of command APDU and response APDU.
Fixed some SW values and whitespace.
